title: 野生眉的三种做法：手工、单仪器与双仪器
intro: 同样叫“野生眉”，用的工具、皮肤反馈和留色周期完全不同。看清手工针片、单仪器与双仪器各自的擅长边界，能避免只按名称盲选。
intro_en: Three methods fall under hair-stroke brows, yet they differ in tools, healing behaviour and retention guides. Understanding what manual blades, single instruments and dual instruments do helps avoid choosing by name alone.

sections.title: 手工野生眉：针片逐根入色，适合条件适配的原有眉架
sections.title_en: Manual hair-stroke brows: hand-placed strokes for established frameworks
sections.description: 手工野生眉不接电源，完全依靠老师手持针片控制落点、倾斜角与走向。手工不是“为了省钱才选的替代项”，但它在操作特点上确实与仪器有明显区别：有结痂期、存在尴尬期，前一周颜色可能偏深，门店经验参考恢复期约7天、留色约1年。至于能不能做手工，不是靠网上流传的“基础好才行”一句话定死，而是结合原生眉基础和想要的效果，到店面诊后判断。
sections.description_en: Manual brows rely on a handheld blade rather than a motorised device, placing individual strokes by hand angle and pressure. It is not merely a budget alternative, yet its healing profile differs clearly: there is a scabbing phase, the colour can look darker during the first week, recovery is discussed as around seven days and retention around one year. Suitability is judged in person based on natural brows and the look you want.

sections.title: 画派仪器野生眉：单仪器匹配原生毛发粗细
sections.title_en: Huapai single-instrument brows: matching natural hair texture
sections.description: 仪器操作的优势在于出针频率稳定、线条更细腻均匀。单仪器方案会在面诊看清你的原生眉毛后，单独选用电流仪或半抛机：细软偏浅的眉毛讲究线条柔和衔接，粗硬深色的眉毛需要结构清晰。同等基础上，仪器呈现的视觉毛流感往往比手工更细腻通透，且没有尴尬期，留色经验参考约2–3年。
sections.description_en: Motorised instruments offer consistent stroke depth and fine edges. The single-instrument service selects either an electric or rotary machine after checking hair thickness and tone. On comparable brow bases, instruments typically deliver cleaner visual hair-stroke transition without a heavy flaking phase, with an experience-based retention guide of two to three years.

sections.title: 画派双仪器初绒野生眉：骨架与初绒毛感分台完成
sections.title_en: Huapai dual-instrument layered brows: separating skeleton and softness
sections.description: 双仪器不是“把同一条线描两遍”，而是让半抛机走决定轮廓和立体折角的主线条，让电流仪负责穿插细腻的绒毛过渡线。这种配合对眉眼距较局促、眉峰偏平、或者需要同时调整面部折叠视觉感的脸型特别有用。它同样没有尴尬期，具体留色参考约2–3年，自然代谢后底色干净，不积红底、蓝底或灰底。
sections.description_en: Dual-instrument layering does not mean tracing the same line twice: the rotary tool builds structural guide strokes aligned with the brow bone, while the electric tool adds light, feathery secondary strokes. This helps when brow arch support or gentle framing around the eye area is needed, also without a scabbing-heavy awkward stage and with two to three years as a working retention guide.

sections.title: 与丝雾眉、绒雾眉的区别与到店确认
sections.title_en: Distinction from shaded brows and in-studio assessment
sections.description: 除了三种纯线条野生眉，门店也做丝雾眉与绒雾眉——如果你平时习惯画偏实一点的雾状眉妆感，或者原生眉底色/毛量情况更适合“线条加底雾”，也可以在到店免费设计（约30–45分钟）时一并比对。所有项目均由乐乐老师本人一对一操作、不做升单，一年内免费补色，具体项目价格以大众点评当期门店信息为准。
sections.description_en: Beyond the three hair-stroke options, the studio also offers silk-shaded and velvet-shaded brows for clients who prefer soft powder-makeup fullness. During your free 30–45 minute consultation with Lele—one-to-one with no upselling—you can preview shapes first before deciding. All services include free touch-ups within one year.
